grandparents_cupboard.reason: Lamb, root vegetables, pearl barley, stock, kale and garden herbs are all plain home-kitchen foods.

supermarket.reason: Lamb neck fillet, swede, kale and pearl barley are all everyday Tesco lines at ordinary prices.

basic_kitchen.reason: It needs only a knife, board and a lidded casserole, and uses simple browning and simmering.

works.reason: 500g lamb, 100g barley and 1.7 litres of liquid simmered for 75 minutes gives a tender, well-proportioned broth for four, and 8 minutes is right for shredded kale.

honest_times.reason: 25 minutes covers dicing the lamb and vegetables plus 10 minutes of browning and softening, and 85 minutes of cook time fits a 75-minute simmer plus coming to the boil.

honest_ingredients.reason: Every listed ingredient and seasoning is used, the names match their ids, and nothing beyond water is added.

seasonal_feel.reason: A hot lamb and barley broth suits early January, and 200g of kale named in the title is a substantial part of the bowl.

plain_voice.reason: The steps are short, plain British instructions a beginner could follow.

hearty_healthy.reason: Lean lamb, barley, root vegetables and greens make a filling, balanced family dinner.
